self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Traveler's Path: after the Traveler attacks and hits an opponent, ATK increases for 8s (5s ICD, works off-field). Traveler-only - the weapon does nothing on any other character. The magnitude follows the leaderboard's chosen refinement (R1 +16%, R3 +24%, R5 +40%); this weapon refines through Snezhnaya's Statues of the Seven rather than duplicates, so R3 is the realistic default and the builder's R1 default should usually be changed. The 5 Elemental Energy restore is not modelled.

Traveler's Path: +6% CRIT DMG per Element the Traveler has resonated with (7 exist). Pick the number of Statues of the Seven unlocked. This half of the passive does not exist at R1 - its param is 0 there - so the R1 tier is all zeroes and refinementStates turns it on from R2 upward at a flat 6% per Element (it does not scale further with refinement).

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R3 (requested explicitly; refines via Snezhnaya Statues of the Seven, not duplicates).
